title: NexusStrategyGenerateResponse
description: Body of a generated candidate (HTTP 200). `document` is the committed candidate at `new_revision`, so the caller replaces its candidate with this document instead of predicting server normalization. Success means structurally legal and nothing more: generate performs no validate, simulate, approve or apply step, and `warnings` are the passing round's semantic warnings.

new_revision.description: Revision the kernel committed; always the request's `base_revision` plus one.

warnings.description: Semantic warnings the passing round carried, even when empty. They never block generation; a warning is reported, never dropped.

path.description: Dot path to the offending field (e.g. `states[1].enter[0].name`).

severity.description: Severity of the diagnostic. A generated document carries warnings only; an error would have kept the round from passing.
